description: Confirm the pending saved-method plan payment only after the user explicitly approved the displayed prepared quote. Revalidates the quote and default method, checks the original signup, sends at most one confirmation request, and never retries an ambiguous charge.

confirmationToken.description: Confirmation token returned by prepare_plan_payment for this payment.

confirmed.description: Must be literally true, and only after the user explicitly said yes to the complete payment summary.

name: confirm_plan_payment
title: Confirm Plan Payment
